body: When the dependency cache misses, the CI pipeline takes about twice as long. Restore the cache before compiling, keyed on the lockfile hash.
title: Cold cache doubles the pipeline time

body: Snapshot tests failed on one runner in five because map iteration order leaked into the rendered output. Sort keys before rendering.
title: Flaky snapshot tests come from unsorted maps

body: A 40 megapixel photograph exhausted worker memory while generating thumbnails. Reject inputs above a pixel ceiling before decoding.
title: Image thumbnails need a size ceiling

body: Readers saw a half-built search index during deploys. Build into a fresh directory and swap a symlink when complete.
title: Search index rebuild must be atomic

body: The RSS feed showed posts dated the day before for readers east of UTC. Always render feed timestamps in UTC with an explicit offset.
title: Timezones in feed timestamps

body: Server-side rendering through a headless browser was tried for diagrams and dropped: startup cost per page was over a second.
title: Rendering pages in a headless browser

body: The link checker reported success on links that redirected to a 404 page. Follow redirects and check the final status.
title: Broken internal links hide behind redirects

body: Exporting a page with a two-thousand-row table took minutes. Paginate tables before the PDF renderer sees them.
title: Large tables slow the PDF export

body: Changing a layout template did not rebuild pages that used it. The dependency graph must include templates, not only content files.
title: Incremental builds miss template changes

body: Russian pages produced hundreds of false spelling errors under the English dictionary. Choose the dictionary from the page's language tag.
title: Spell checker dictionary per language

body: Draft pages leaked into the sitemap and were indexed by search engines. Filter drafts before writing sitemap.xml.
title: Sitemap must exclude drafts

body: Uploading thousands of assets at once hit the storage rate limit. Retry with exponential backoff and random jitter.
title: Retry uploads to object storage with jitter

body: Unknown language names in fenced code blocks crashed the highlighter. Fall back to plain text.
title: Code block highlighting needs a language fallback

body: The glossary sorted Cyrillic terms after all Latin ones in byte order. Use a collation for the page's locale.
title: Locale-aware sorting of the glossary page

body: A single stylesheet for every page type was rejected: it grew past 400 kilobytes and blocked first paint.
title: One giant CSS bundle

body: Authors saw stale drafts in the preview server because responses were cached. Disable caching for preview responses.
title: Preview server must not cache drafts

body: Footnotes were numbered across the whole book, confusing readers of single pages. Number footnotes per page.
title: Footnote numbering restarts per page

body: Images without alternative text were invisible to screen reader users. The build now refuses an image without alt text.
title: Alt text is required on every image

body: Client-side math rendering made pages jump as formulas loaded. Render formulas to markup during the build.
title: Math formulas render at build time

body: Readers landing on deep pages could not find their way up. Every page now shows breadcrumbs to its section.
title: Breadcrumbs for deep landing pages

body: File system modification times were reset by checkout, so every page claimed to be updated today. Read the last commit date from git history instead.
title: Git history dates for last-modified

body: The file watcher opened a handle per directory and hit the operating system limit on large sites. Watch the root recursively instead.
title: Watch mode leaks file handles

body: Search engines indexed old documentation versions over the current one. Every versioned page declares the latest version as canonical.
title: Cross-version links need canonical URLs

body: Renaming a heading broke every external link to its anchor. Allow an explicit anchor id that survives renames.
title: Heading anchors must be stable

body: Two builds of the same commit differed because of embedded timestamps and random asset hashes. Derive both from the content.
title: Build output must be reproducible

body: Keeping rendered HTML in a database for faster rebuilds was rejected; invalidation was harder than rebuilding.
title: Storing rendered pages in the database

body: Diagrams with white backgrounds glared in dark mode. Export diagrams with transparent backgrounds and theme-aware strokes.
title: Dark mode images need transparent backgrounds

body: Matches in page titles were ranked like matches in body text, burying the obvious page. Weight title matches higher.
title: Search ranking boosts titles

body: New writers did not know how to preview their changes. The contributor guide now starts with the preview command.
title: Contributor guide must mention the preview command

body: Translated pages fell behind the English source without anyone noticing. Record the source revision in each translation and flag stale ones.
title: Translation files drift from the source

body: Moving pages between sections broke inbound links. Keep a redirect map and generate redirects on every build.
title: Redirect map for moved pages

body: Resizing images on a bounded worker pool cut build time by half without exhausting memory.
title: Parallel image processing with a worker pool

body: Pages with several embedded videos loaded megabytes before the reader scrolled. Load video players only when visible.
title: Embedded videos load lazily

body: Deep tables of contents overwhelmed the sidebar. Show headings down to level three only.
title: Table of contents depth is three levels

body: Printed pages wasted the first sheet on menus. A print stylesheet hides navigation and expands links.
title: Print stylesheet hides navigation

body: Friday deploys led to incidents nobody could watch over the weekend.
retired_reason: replaced by the Tuesday and Thursday schedule
title: Old deploy schedule caused weekend incidents

body: Checking external links hammered small sites and got our runner blocked. Limit requests per host and cache results for a day.
title: Link checker must respect rate limits

body: Emoji shortcodes in headings produced broken anchor ids. Strip emoji when generating anchors.
title: Emoji shortcodes break in headings

body: Long identifiers in prose overflowed the screen on narrow phones. Allow breaking long words in body text.
title: Very long words overflow on phones

body: The client-side search index grew to eight megabytes. Split it by section and load only what the reader searches.
title: Search index size must be split by section

body: Hand-written release notes missed changes. Generate them from pull request labels and edit afterwards.
title: Release notes are generated from labels

body: A typo in the site configuration silently disabled the sitemap. Validate configuration against a schema and stop on unknown keys.
title: Config validation fails fast

body: Pages whose file names were typed on different systems collided or went missing. Normalise file names to NFC before routing.
title: Unicode normalisation of file names

body: Machine translation of whole pages was rejected: reviewers could not keep up and errors shipped silently.
title: Auto-translating pages with a model

body: Client-side diagram rendering shifted the page layout. Render diagrams to SVG during the build.
title: Mermaid diagrams render at build time

body: Every preview reload jumped to the top of the page. Preserve the scroll position across reloads.
title: Hot reload drops scroll position

body: Code samples in the guides drifted from the real API. Extract samples and run them as tests in CI.
title: Code samples are tested
